parts.note_add: Tandem master cylinder with the level-sensor reservoir on top; strips into reservoir set, bushes, joint bolt with check valve and spring, secondary-piston stop bolt and O-ring, stop ring, primary piston, secondary piston and spring (S-002 11-17). On rear-drum cars the check valve goes in with its six-hole face toward the cylinder body (S-002 11-18). Atkins Rotary sells FA07-43-400 new (OEM-quality, 134 USD, in stock, 'fits 12A with drum brakes') and lists FA18-43-400 beside it; an rx7club thread gives FA01-43-400 as the 81-83 S/GS number and FA18-43-400 as GSL, so check the number cast on the car's cylinder. Nisshinbo (Mazda's supplier) makes a limited reproduction, NSB-102, 398 USD via JDM Car Parts. Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.110 (4340A-1).

FA16-43-800 is NLA at Atkins Rotary (145 USD, out of stock, 'getting very hard to obtain'); the only aftermarket listing found is a PRIOR 9700158 remanufactured unit on RockAuto (1983 listing, out of stock); used OEM boosters are sold by Autopartone, and rx7club owners report local rebuilds (~80 USD) and Cardone remans. The booster-to-firewall gasket H001-43-443 is 1.88 USD at Atkins. Inside: front and rear shells, diaphragm, power piston, valve rod and plunger (serviced only as an assembly), reaction disc, air silencer and filter, push rod, front and rear seals (S-002 11-21..22).

The two rubber seals between the reservoir and the master cylinder (0305-49-686B) are 4.50 USD each at Atkins Rotary, in stock. Keep the reservoir at least 3/4 full while bleeding (S-002 11-24). No listing for the reservoir FA07-49-680 itself was found.

Atkins Rotary sells B093-49-580 as the 72-91 master cylinder cap (15.25 USD, in stock); Mazdatrix lists the 79-85 brake fluid cap under GA02-49-580B, discontinued by Mazda. Check which number the cap on the car carries.

Not stocked by Atkins Rotary (they list only the 84-88 kit HA18-49-610A); an rx7club thread names G001-49-610 as the 81-83 S/GS kit and FA18-49-610 as the GSL kit. Spareto cross-references G001-49-610 to Frenkit 120058, Autofren Seinsa D1485 and ERT 200334 (about 5 EUR each, 28-day dispatch).
Frenkit 120058 lists G001-49-640 among its OE numbers; its piston diameter of 20.6 mm matches the 20.64 mm bore.

No listing found for F001-49-720. The factory kit furnishes the silicone grease that goes on the valve rod and plunger, the whole reaction disc, the diaphragm's outer bead and both seal lips (S-002 11-22..23); the valve rod and plunger are serviced only as an assembly (S-002 11-21).

The factory hose carried a press-fit one-way check valve marked with a flow arrow; air must pass from the booster end to the engine end only, and a bad valve is replaced with the hose (S-002 11-20). Check whether the new line fitted since the Weber conversion carries a check valve. Used OEM two-piece hose sets with clamps sell at Autopartone (30 USD).

Mazdatrix sells the set of four FA01-26-38Z shoes for 81-85 drum cars (36.38 USD). Leading/trailing shoes; grease the shoe-to-backing-plate, shoe-to-piston and shoe-to-anchor contacts on assembly (S-002 11-10). Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.87 (2610A-1).

Atkins Rotary sells FA01-26-251 (OEM-quality, 59.50 USD each, in stock, 'hard to get'). rx7club owners report cheap Centric drums with an oversized centre bore that would not seat on the axle flange, and that 81-85 drums do not fit 79-80 cars. Held by attaching screws; release the parking brake fully before pulling it (S-002 11-8).

Atkins Rotary stocks the bearing 8871-26-151A (27.25 USD) with its retaining collar 8531-26-152 (27.50 USD), seal 0187-26-154 (7.50 USD) and spacer 0259-26-155 (8.75 USD). The collar is destroyed on removal: grind one side to 0.5 mm and break it with a chisel, then press a new collar on dry (S-002 9-8..9). No maker bearing number was found.

Atkins Rotary stocks FA01-26-610A (right) and FA01-26-710A (left) at 25.75 USD each; Nisshinbo makes a reproduction pair, NSB-105, 169 USD via JDM Car Parts. Dorman W37549 (right) and W37548 (left) are listed as replacements, 3/4 in bore (check). Inside: two pistons, two piston cups, filling blocks, spring, dust boots, bleeder screw and cap, steel ball (S-002 11-10).
Carries the two shoe-adjusting hole plugs and the arrow that marks the star-wheel direction (S-002 11-10..11). Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.87 (2610A-1).

Raybestos H17275 and Centric 118.45003 appear in search-result titles as rear drum hardware kits for the 81-85 RX-7; neither listing could be opened (Vivid Racing 403, RockAuto does not render), so fitment and contents are unverified: check that a kit includes this part before buying.

Raybestos H17275 and Centric 118.45003 appear in search-result titles as rear drum hardware kits for the 81-85 RX-7; neither listing could be opened (Vivid Racing 403, RockAuto does not render), so fitment and contents are unverified: check that a kit includes this part before buying.
Genuine FA01-26-345 is listed on Amazon (page did not load; price unknown); the 1985 manual calls it the shoe retaining spring, removed with its guide pin (S-002 11-9).
Genuine FA01-26-391 hold-down pins are listed on eBay (page did not load; price unknown).
Item 13 'Cup & Boot set' in the 1985 rear drum structural view (S-002 11-8); no listing found.
Mazdatrix stocks the 79-85 rear drum bleeder 0259-33-691 at 6.58 USD.

FA01-26-630 (R) and FA01-26-640 (L) are discontinued by Mazda: NLA at Atkins Rotary (75 USD when stocked) and at Mazdatrix. Adjust through hole A in the backing plate: turn the star wheel in the arrow direction until the wheel locks, then back off 3-4 notches (S-002 11-10..11).
Pushed clear through hole B in the backing plate while the star wheel is backed off (S-002 11-11).
The parking brake cable hooks straight onto this lever (S-002 11-9). Atkins Rotary has the right-hand lever FA01-26-810 at 25 USD, 'no longer available but quite a few left'.
